description: A PHP class defining a detailed model for a Project entity within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API. It serializes project data including customer info and project administrators into an array format suitable for API responses.

classes.name: ProjectDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed information of a Project entity, including customer details and project administrators for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Project entity, setting attribute filters and names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Project entity into an array format, enriching it with project administrators' details.
